name: Azimut
verdict: The asset and wealth management group Azimut Holding S.p.A., listed in Milan; its named shareholders are Timone Fiduciaria (21.15%) and Helikon Investments (5.82%), the rest is free float. Nothing found.
note: Global Partner of Red Bull Italy SailGP Team for the 2026 season. This is the asset and wealth management group, not the yacht builder Azimut|Benetti (Azimut Yachts): the team's announcement calls Azimut an 'independent global group in asset and wealth management' and says the Azimut Investments logo is on the hull of the Italian F50 (pressmare.it, 2026-01-15), and SailGP's team page links the partner to azimut-group.com.
